outcome: forced expiratory volume in the first second (FEV1)
cohort: 80 patients with stage I non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treated at Cangzhou People's Hospital between December 2019 and January 2022, divided equally into segmentectomy and lobectomy groups.
finding: Thoracoscopic segmentectomy, compared to lobectomy, for stage I NSCLC results in longer operation time but less intraoperative blood loss, shorter hospital stay, less postoperative pain, and a lower incidence of complications.
